official_references.official_effect_text:
If this card is detached from an Xyz Monster [b]and[/b] sent to the Graveyard to activate that monster's effect: [b]You can[/b] [b]banish[/b] this card from your Graveyard, [b]then[/b] [b]target[/b] 1 "Raidraptor" card in your Graveyard; add it to your hand. [b]You can[/b] only use this effect of "Raidraptor - Skull Eagle" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b]. An Xyz Monster that was Summoned using this card on the field as Xyz Material gains this effect.
● If it is Xyz Summoned: It gains 300 ATK.

If this face-up card would leave the field, [b]banish[/b] it [b]instead[/b]. [b]You can[/b] only use each of the following effects of "Floowandereeze & Robina" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b], [b]and[/b] [b]cannot[/b] Special Summon during the turn you activate either effect. If this card is Normal Summoned: [b]You can[/b] add 1 Level 4 or lower Winged Beast monster from your Deck to your hand, [b]then[/b] [b]immediately[/b] after this effect resolves, [b]you can[/b] Normal Summon 1 Winged Beast monster. If a Winged Beast monster is Normal Summoned to your field while this card is banished: [b]You can[/b] add this card to your hand.

[b]Once[/b] [b]per turn[/b], if you control no monsters: [b]You can[/b] send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard, [b]then[/b] activate 1 of these effects.
● [b]Target[/b] 1 Zombie-Type monster with 0 DEF in your Graveyard; Special Summon it.
● [b]Target[/b] 1 of your banished Zombie-Type monsters with 0 DEF; [b]return[/b] it to the Graveyard.
[b]You can[/b] only activate 1 "Shiranui Style Synthesis" [b]per turn[/b].
